title: K33 Cycle Basis to Levi H1 Boundary
planned_goal: Map local [9,4,4] K33 cycle bases into Levi H1=81 and compute E4 overlap.
corrected_result: No canonical map exists from K33 chart cycles into the 160-edge point-line Levi graph using only the chart data.
reason: K33 chart edges are W33 nonedges, not Levi flag-edges. A nonedge has mu=4 possible center/lift gauges, so an H1(Levi) embedding requires extra connector data.
boundary: K33 cycle homology is a local nonedge-cycle layer. Levi H1=81 remains the point-line incidence cycle layer.
